messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — Acme asked for per-route throughput caps + a burst addon. They want predictable billing and no surprise throttles. Need quick alignment on pricing shape and contract constraints.
Sam (AE): Confirmed. Their main ask: stable baseline for product pages + ability to spike for campaigns. They will pay for priority bursts but want a clear ceiling for liability.
Ben (Solutions): From sales side: two viable commercial shapes: (A) soft cap + paid burst credits (preferred by GTM), (B) hard cap with optional overage negotiations. We should define what a ‘burst’ buys them (tokens, time-window, priority).
Lina (Eng): Technical reality: per-route enforcement touches routing + quotas. Options and rough effort: 1) soft cap (warnings + metrics) — minimal infra, 1 sprint; 2) hard cap (rejects 429) — small infra, 2 sprints; 3) priority lane (tokenized burst bank + routing priority) — moderate infra change, ~6 sprints.
Maya (PM): Lina — can you paste a small policy sketch for the burst bank so legal/sales understand mechanics?
Lina (Eng): Sure — sketch below:
```
policy: {
  route_id: string,
  baseline_qps: int,
  soft_cap_pct: int, // threshold to emit warning
  burst_bank: {
    credits_total: int, // tokens purchased
    credits_window_secs: int,
    consumption_rate: float // credits per token generated
  },
  fallback: enum { degrade, reject, route-to-lowcost }
}
```
Ben (Solutions): Nice. Sales note: customers will expect a clear conversion between "credits" and actual TPS/seconds. We should publish conversion examples.
Devon (Legal): High-level contract needs: 1) definition of credits and expiry, 2) fair-use clause for sustained spikes, 3) liability cap for degraded performance during bursts, 4) termination right if abuse. Also we need billing reconciliation language for partial-window usage. :page_facing_up:
Priya (GTM): Recommend pilot launch before GA — pick one customer (Acme) + one different profile (e.g., streaming app) to validate conversions and UI. Need dashboards showing: credit balance, credits used by route, cost estimate if they exceed.
Maya (PM): Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- Console controls to set baseline_qps and buy credits (UI + API)
- Billing pipeline exposing credits consumed per billing cycle
- Route-level dashboards + alerts (threshold + low-credit)
- Contract T&Cs + usage doc + conversion examples
- At least 1 signed pilot and 1 engineering smoke test on dedicated infra
- Post-pilot SLO review and pricing tweak window (2 weeks)
Can engineering commit to a minimal MVP (soft cap + credits purchase + metrics) in 2 sprints?
Lina (Eng): Yes for MVP soft-cap + credits purchase + metrics telemetry — 2 sprints assumptions: no priority routing, no cross-region bursting. We’ll need design tickets for Console + billing events.
Sam (AE): Sales ops: we need SKU naming and price bands for pilot offers. I can draft 2 price tiers: Small (100k credits/mo), Medium (1M credits/mo) with per-credit overage.
Ben (Solutions): Also propose a temporary commercial guardrail: unlimited credits for first 30 days of pilot, then apply purchased credits — simplifies testing.
Devon (Legal): One more ask: include an audit log requirement (who bought credits, who consumed them) for enterprise customers. We should add that to the compliance checklist.
ops-bot: Reminder — engineering sprint planning meeting in 30m.
Maya (PM): Action items: 1) Lina will create tech RFC + estimate (ETA EOD tomorrow). 2) Ben/Sam to draft pilot commercial terms and credit conversion examples (ETA 48h). 3) Devon to draft contract clauses and audit log requirements (ETA 3 days). 4) Priya to prepare dashboard mockups and pilot comms (ETA 72h).
Ben (Solutions): I'll also prepare a short FAQ for sales to set expectations.
Maya (PM): Thanks everyone — let's target a pilot kickoff next week. :rocket:
